from common import *
import argparse,gc,traceback
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import _zscore_by_day
from backtest.scripts.maintenance import experiment_harness as native

STATE=BASE/'docs/harness-state.json'
LAD=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/strategies/cohort-ladder/quantile10-p50-20261107-v1'
S5=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/strategies/topk-dropout/v2-top5-hold-f100/variants/bt-v5'
old_bundle=ROOT/'backtest/result/20261113_weekly_h5_four'
def note(t):
    s=native.inspect_state(STATE,repo_root=ROOT,check_drift=True)
    native.append_event(STATE,dict(type='note',text=t),expected_revision=s['revision'],repo_root=ROOT)
def signals(good):
    assert good
    classifier=read(CAMPAIGN/'classifier/metrics/evaluation.json')['primary_predictions'];check(classifier)
    cols=['date','target_date','predicted_label',*['p_'+v for v in STYLES]]
    pred=pd.read_csv(ROOT/classifier['path'],usecols=cols,parse_dates=['date','target_date']).sort_values('date')
    probabilities=['p_'+v for v in STYLES]
    assert np.allclose(pred[probabilities].sum(axis=1),1) and np.array_equal(pred.predicted_label.to_numpy(),np.array(STYLES)[pred[probabilities].to_numpy().argmax(axis=1)])
    baseline=read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')['ensemble'];check(baseline)
    v5=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/baseline['path']).iloc[:,0]
    control=pd.read_pickle(old_bundle/'v5-ensemble.pkl').iloc[:,0];assert np.array_equal(v5.values,control.values) and v5.index.equals(control.index);del control
    dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(v5.index.get_level_values('datetime').unique()).sort_values();assert np.array_equal(pred.date.values,dates[:-1]) and np.array_equal(pred.target_date.values,dates[1:])
    scores={'v5':v5};sources={'v5':baseline}
    for v in good:
        p=read(BASE/'docs'/f'predictions-joint-{v}.json')['ensemble'];check(p)
        scores[v]=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/p['path']).iloc[:,0];sources[v]=p
    assert all(x.index.equals(v5.index) and np.isfinite(x).all() for x in scores.values())
    ds=v5.index.get_level_values('datetime');route_info={}
    for key in (['hard_signal','soft_signal','soft_p_v5'] if 'P' in good else ['hard_signal','soft_signal']):
        alignment='target_date'
        conf=pred.set_index(alignment).reindex(dates)
        decision=conf.predicted_label.where(conf.predicted_label.isin(good),'v5')
        missing=conf.predicted_label.isna()
        if alignment=='target_date':assert missing.sum()==1 and missing.iloc[0]
        else:assert missing.sum()==1 and missing.iloc[-1]
        weights=pd.DataFrame(0.,index=dates,columns=list(scores))
        if key.startswith('hard'):
            for v in scores:weights[v]=decision.eq(v).astype(float)
        else:
            for v in good:
                if key!='soft_p_v5' or v!='P':weights[v]=conf['p_'+v].fillna(0.)
            weights['v5']=(1-weights[good].sum(axis=1)).clip(0,1)
        assert np.allclose(weights.sum(axis=1),1) and weights.min().min()>=0
        out=np.zeros(len(v5),dtype='float64')
        for v,s in scores.items():
            sc=s if key.startswith('hard') else _zscore_by_day(s)
            out+=weights[v].reindex(ds).to_numpy()*sc.to_numpy()
        assert np.isfinite(out).all()
        path=BUNDLE/f'route-{key}.pkl';pd.DataFrame({'score':out},index=v5.index).to_pickle(path)
        weights.index.name='signal_date';weights.to_csv(BASE/'data'/f'route-{key}-weights.csv')
        route_info[key]=dict(weights_file=fingerprint(BASE/'data'/f'route-{key}-weights.csv'),prediction=fingerprint(path),hard_assignment_days=decision.value_counts().to_dict(),mean_weights=weights.mean().to_dict(),join_key=alignment,missing_forecast_v5_fallback=int(missing.sum()))
    write(BASE/'docs/route-inputs.json',dict(classifier=classifier,permitted_classifier_columns=cols,sources=sources,qualified=good,routes=route_info,clock='For signal t, primary uses prediction produced t-1 targeting t (the expert training membership date), current stock features t, execution t+1. soft_p_v5 sends panic probability to v5. At most current close used.'))
    return route_info

def account(k):
    import qlib
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import run_pred_backtest as bt
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate.strategy_stability_metrics import summarize_stability
    from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
    noteid='wk3mix_20261114_'+k;pred=ROOT/read(BASE/'docs/route-inputs.json')['routes'][k]['prediction']['path'];cfg=LAD/'configs/ladder.yaml'
    before={p.name for p in (ROOT/'backtest/result').iterdir()};note('Start derived offline ladder account '+k)
    orig=qlib.init
    def init(*a,**kw):kw['kernels']=1;return orig(*a,**kw)
    qlib.init=init
    original_prepare=bt.prepare_signal_and_port_cfg
    def prepare(cfg,raw):
        port,filtered,stats=original_prepare(cfg,raw)
        receipt=read(LAD/'docs/ladder-signal.json')
        signature=frame_signature(filtered);assert len(filtered)>0
        for fk in ['shape','index_sha256']:
            if fk in signature:assert signature[fk]==receipt['filtered'][fk]
        assert stats==receipt['filter_stats']
        write(BASE/'docs'/f'account-filter-{k}.json',dict(filter_stats=stats,signature=signature,control=LAD.joinpath('docs/ladder-signal.json').relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()))
        return port,filtered,stats
    bt.prepare_signal_and_port_cfg=prepare
    sys.argv=[str(bt.__file__),'--config',str(cfg),'--pred',str(pred),'--skip-pred-copy','--note',noteid]
    bt.main();new=[x for x in (ROOT/'backtest/result').iterdir() if x.name not in before and x.name.endswith(noteid)];assert len(new)==1
    sd=new[0];link=read(sd/'run_01/mlruns_link.json')
    rp=ROOT/link['backtest_artifacts']/'artifacts/portfolio_analysis/report_normal_1day.pkl';r=pd.read_pickle(rp)
    control=read(LAD/'metrics/ladder.json');cd=pd.read_csv(LAD/'data/ladder-account.csv',index_col=0,parse_dates=True)
    assert len(r)==1454 and r.index.equals(cd.index) and np.allclose(r.bench,cd.bench,rtol=0,atol=1e-12)
    metrics=summarize_stability(r);metrics['session_dir']=str(sd.relative_to(ROOT));net=(1+r['return']-r.cost).cumprod()
    assert abs(net.iloc[-1]-1-metrics['full_period']['cumulative_return'])<1e-10
    p=BASE/'data'/f'account-{k}.csv';r.to_csv(p)
    doc=dict(variant=k,session_dir=str(sd.relative_to(ROOT)),evaluation_mode='historical_selection_window',model_ref=EID,prediction=fingerprint(pred),config=fingerprint(cfg),source_report=fingerprint(rp),portable_daily=fingerprint(p),ensemble=metrics)
    write(BASE/'metrics'/f'account-{k}.json',doc);note('Completed derived offline ladder account '+k+' '+doc['session_dir'])


if __name__=='__main__':
    if len(sys.argv)>1:
        key=sys.argv[1]
        try:account(key)
        except BaseException:
            out=BASE/'docs'/f'account-{key}-failed-{int(time.time())}.json'
            write(out,dict(traceback=traceback.format_exc(),variant=key));note('Account failed '+str(out.relative_to(ROOT)));raise
    else:
        save_source(__file__)
        good=read(BASE/'metrics/comparison.json')['qualified']
        if good:
            routes=signals(good)
            for k in routes:
                if not (BASE/'metrics'/f'account-{k}.json').exists():
                    with (BASE/'docs'/f'account-{k}.log').open('a') as f:subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-u',__file__,k],cwd=ROOT,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
